# Spelling Quest

> Spelling practice built from the exact list a child brings home from school each week. A parent pastes in the list; Spelling Quest finds the letter patterns, splits words into chunks, writes memory tricks and builds a short daily route of seven sprints up to the child's test day. About ten minutes a day, designed so an elementary-school child can practice largely on their own.

- Price: 7 free days (no card, no account), then $40 a year for the whole household, every child and every device. $25 a year for families who already own One Ayah At A Time or Muslim Kids Checklist; $89 a year for all three apps.
- Works in any web browser: iPad, iPhone, Android, laptop. Works offline once loaded.
- Seven sprints: Meet the Words, Sound Out & Build, Missing Letters, Spelling Bee, Arcade, Boss Battle (the words a child missed), Champion Quiz.
- Every day ends with a Paper Power-Up: look, say, cover, write from memory, check, fix.
- Spelling bee mode: spreads a long list across the weeks to a bee date and practices on a stage with judges.
- Privacy: children are known by nickname only; no real names, birthdays, schools or email addresses in the app; no ads, analytics or tracking; no leaderboards or rankings.
